source.title: Tales of Eternia Remastered
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesTales of Eternia RemasteredVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalFantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingFrom opposite skies, voices unite.Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at StakeJourney to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and FreedomFeaturing the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to PlayGameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.Software description provided by the publisher.Related tagsRole playingChoose your difficultyPixel artRaise your statsVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.

source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 8Alcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesFINAL FANTASY RESONANCEReleases 10/22/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - FINAL FANTASY RESONANCEAlcohol Reference, Fantasy Violence, Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingView DLCHope resonates within the crystalsReturn to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. ◆ Cinematic pixel artWhat if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.◆ A return to the familiarA classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.◆ Strategic turn-based battlesExploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.◆ FINAL FANTASY legendsBolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.◆ Hours of side content to discoverThe world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Pre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter PackThis set contains an item that transforms your airship’s appearance into a magitek vessel, along with useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Magitek Airship Passkey x1• Knight’s Greatsword x1• Chestplate of Preparation x1 (Increases EXP gained in battle by a certain amount)• Magicite Shard x1• Tent x3• Mist Potion x3*These bonuses are available only to customers who pre-order the product and are not available to customers who purchase the product after release. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *The airship’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Airship Passkey “ON” under the Items section of the main menu. Early Purchase Bonus: Squire Kickstart PackThis set contains useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.Pack Contents: • Blessed Cuirass x1 (Increase gil obtained by a certain amount)• Mist Ether x1*These bonuses are available only to customers who purchase the product by November 5, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. (PST). *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *This game is only compatible with Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please be aware that it cannot be played on Nintendo Switch™.*There is also a Nintendo Switch™ version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. *It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version over to the Nintendo Switch™ version.*It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ version over to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 8.8 GBNintendo Switch 2: 12.7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
